requirements.evidence: Default map + range fallback in Queue::defaultPrefixFor (app/Models/Queue.php:128-140); custom map wins in prefixForPriority (Queue.php:145-154); validation of canonical int keys (relies on PHP key coercion, Queue.php:182), single A-Z letter (Queue.php:186), unique effective prefixes via `$normalized + self::DEFAULT_PREFIX_MAP` (Queue.php:193-197), empty -> null, enforced in saving hook (Queue.php:204-209); array cast (Queue.php:218) and not in #[Fillable]. Migration adds nullable issue_date, backfills DATE(issued_at), makes NOT NULL, swaps unique index, has down() (add_issue_date migration:17-43). nextCode filters by queue, issue_date and prefix, skips malformed codes, orders by id (Ticket.php:256-277). IssueTicket reads clock once and uses $now for code day, issued_at and issue_date (IssueTicket.php:23-58). Factory derives issue_date from issued_at and allocates by priority/day, keeps explicit code (TicketFactory.php:313-338). UpdateQueue priorityPrefixMap null/[]/validated, ValidationException keyed priority_prefix_map before mutating (UpdateQueue.php:78-102). Docs and CHANGELOG updated.

conventions.evidence: Domain write goes through UpdateQueue with existing Gate authorization (UpdateQueue.php:80); model throws InvalidArgumentException as specified; migrations follow generated-file naming/stub layout with reversible down(); mass-assignment kept deliberate (Fillable unchanged at Queue.php:117); business-rules.md, database-schema.md and CHANGELOG [Unreleased] updated; PHPDoc on new/changed public methods (Queue.php:156-166, Ticket.php:239-254).

security.evidence: Authorization stays first in UpdateQueue (Gate::forUser($actor)->authorize('update', $queue)) before validation; map strictly validated server-side (regex `/^[A-Z]$/D`, int keys); map excluded from mass assignment, tested in QueuePrefixTest.php:725-726; preg_quote used when building the code regex (Ticket.php:270). No UI/Livewire surface touched.

tests.evidence: New QueuePrefixTest covers default/range fallback dataset, custom map, empty->null, all invalid-map cases incl. `{"0":"E"}` and `{"0":"P"}`, UpdateQueue set/keep/clear, ValidationException leaving queue unchanged, unauthorized actor and mass-assignment. TicketDailyCodeTest covers independent prefixes, custom prefixes, day restart, same-instant issue_date, malformed/legacy A codes, N999->N1000->N1001, factory by issued_at day, unique index per day. Existing tests updated to N codes, not weakened. Missing: no test of the migration backfill/down, and no admin (non-owner) authorization path for the map.

simplicity.evidence: Reuses existing nextCode scan and IssueTicket lock/retry; uniqueness check is a one-liner array union + array_unique (Queue.php:193-195); validation lives once in Queue::normalizePriorityPrefixMap and is reused by UpdateQueue and the saving hook. Only small defensive extras (is_string check in prefixForPriority, Queue.php:149).

readability.evidence: Clear names (defaultPrefixFor, prefixForPriority, normalizePriorityPrefixMap), explanatory comments on non-obvious points (PHP key coercion at Queue.php:180-181, single clock read at IssueTicket.php:21-22, index ordering in migration docblock). Only nit: stray blank line before `});` at QueuePrefixTest.php:727.

scope.evidence: All changes serve the task: models, IssueTicket, UpdateQueue, factory, two migrations, docs, CHANGELOG and tests. No UI, totem API or call-ordering changes.

issues.explanation: The backfill of issue_date from DATE(issued_at) and the index swap/down() are not exercised by any test with pre-existing rows.
Authorization test covers an outsider only; an admin-allowed / employee-denied case for priorityPrefixMap would document the owner/admin rule more fully.
Stray empty line before the closing `});` that Pint/sibling style would not keep.

review.summary: The change adds priority-derived ticket prefixes with a validated per-queue map, a daily per-prefix sequence backed by tickets.issue_date and a new unique index, single-clock issuance, factory alignment and UpdateQueue support, with docs and CHANGELOG updated. Every requirement and contract item is met, with thorough tests for validation, sequencing, day rollover and authorization. Only minor gaps remain (no migration backfill test, a small test-style nit), so I would approve with nits.
